title: Higher Education and Research on the Eve of the 2026 Election
grammar: Recap: contrast with viszont and ezzel szemben
goal: I can sum up the debate on higher education and research before the election of 2026 and the change of government, with dates (*választás, mandátum, miniszterelnök*).
I can set two views against each other with *viszont* and *ezzel szemben* (*a kormány szerint …, a bírálók szerint viszont …*).
I can report, with attribution, how each side judged the period.
